status: Frozen before Stage 5 evaluation; exploratory retrospective processed-signal research
scope: No new selection; both sensor-only Ridge references retained; no default or target-dependent switching
issue_anchor: First parsed timestamp, inherited Stage 2 grid; never first valid timestamp
partition_anchor: Predetermined first valid Dexcom timestamp from Stage 2, verified against stream

partition_rules.purge: All other origins; target_time equal to either boundary crosses the earlier half-open partition
partition_rules.support: Every minute in [issue-60m,issue] valid; exact issue+30m valid for eligibility/scoring. Intermediate future cells are not required by regression.

adequacy.basis: Retained existing corrected proposal minimums (not a statistical guarantee); distinct from rank feasibility. No new 80% per-24h gate is inferred from Stage 4's 48h coverage gate. Report per-phase minute coverage locally.

adaptation: One fixed median(target-base_prediction), first phase only; new 24h experiment; no later updates
population_models: Reproduce only frozen selected Ridge outer refits on original outer-training participants; no inner search; verify against stored Stage 3 predictions before evaluation

interval.score: abs(target-prediction), separately per participant and variant
interval.rank: Exact rational arithmetic for decimal alpha: k=ceil((n+1)*(1-alpha)); sorted_scores[k-1]
interval.insufficient: INSUFFICIENT_CALIBRATION if n<100 or k>n; no capped rank
interval.nonfinite: Any non-finite/negative calibration score invalidates calibration with explicit INVALID_CALIBRATION_SCORES cause; never discard and proceed
interval.interval_score: Deferred; no Winkler score in this initial implementation

failure_handling.sensor: Dexcom GL only; no stream substitution
failure_handling.bounds_basis: Inherited Stage 2 source validity rule only; no new physiological threshold
failure_handling.duplicates: Reject all duplicate timestamps; CONFLICTING_DUPLICATE for conflicting values, DUPLICATE_TIMESTAMP otherwise
failure_handling.stale_basis: Existing proposal engineering threshold; evaluated only on revealed valid readings. Missing current cell always suppresses point regardless of age.
failure_handling.future_access: Only event_time<=issue consumed for prediction; actual arrival times unknown
failure_handling.resumption: First scheduled issue with all 61 consecutive minute cells valid
failure_handling.target: Evaluator only, exact t+30 reference; missing target does not suppress an otherwise valid point

dropout.placement: One gap per participant per separate duration scenario, starting at first inherited five-minute grid timestamp >= anchor+72h; no seed needed; deterministic timestamp rule, never performance-based
dropout.mode: A: input/transport loss before feature construction; evaluator retains clean exact reference targets
dropout.offsets_and_quantiles: Clean first/second-phase artifacts frozen in all scenarios
dropout.scheduled: All inherited grid issues with issue-60m>=anchor+48h, through recording end; includes invalid histories and missing/outside-recording targets
dropout.matched: Intersection of clean/dropout accepted and scoreable origins, separately by variant/nominal level

aggregation.equal_participant: Compute metrics per contributing participant first then arithmetic mean; omit undefined metrics, report denominator and absent participants
aggregation.pooled: Compute directly over all scored windows; RMSE is sqrt pooled mean squared error
aggregation.variation: Min/max participant empirical coverage and mean width; local participant evidence retained
aggregation.empty_slice: Zero counts; metrics undefined, no imputed zero error; explicit contributing/absent participant counts

limitations: Excluded from model fitting and interval calibration; outcomes from this cohort have previously been examined, so this analysis remains exploratory.
Nominal coverage separate from measured held-out empirical coverage; exchangeability not established for dependent overlapping windows.
Processed released signals include upstream interpolation; original observations and actual availability unresolved. Application access isolation cannot undo upstream processing.
Stage 4 48h adaptation worsened >180 slice MAE by 0.570931 mg/dL and increased underprediction. Preserve this trade-off; do not tune against evaluation outcomes.
No live/prospective validation, clinical efficacy, dosing or guaranteed coverage claims; permissions remain unresolved.
